sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_outbox" ("seq" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "row_key" TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(entity, row_key));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_state" ("name" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "value" TEXT);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "gardens" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "bounds" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TRIGGER gardens_outbox_insert AFTER INSERT ON gardens WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sync_state WHERE name = 'applying') BEGIN DELETE FROM sync_outbox WHERE entity = 'gardens' AND row_key = NEW.id;INSERT INTO sync_outbox (entity, row_key) VALUES ('gardens', NEW.id);END

CREATE TRIGGER gardens_outbox_update AFTER UPDATE ON gardens WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sync_state WHERE name = 'applying') BEGIN DELETE FROM sync_outbox WHERE entity = 'gardens' AND row_key = NEW.id;INSERT INTO sync_outbox (entity, row_key) VALUES ('gardens', NEW.id);END

CREATE TRIGGER gardens_outbox_delete AFTER DELETE ON gardens WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sync_state WHERE name = 'applying') BEGIN DELETE FROM sync_outbox WHERE entity = 'gardens' AND row_key = OLD.id;INSERT INTO sync_outbox (entity, row_key) VALUES ('gardens', OLD.id);END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "zones" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "garden_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES gardens (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'other', "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NULL, "area_m2" REAL NULL, "soil_texture" TEXT NULL, "ph" REAL NULL, "ph_measured_at" TEXT NULL, "sun_exposure" TEXT NULL, "irrigation" TEXT NULL, "covered" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("covered" IN (0, 1)), "polygon" TEXT NULL, "layer" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TRIGGER zones_outbox_insert AFTER INSERT ON zones WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sync_state WHERE name = 'applying') BEGIN DELETE FROM sync_outbox WHERE entity = 'zones' AND row_key = NEW.id;INSERT INTO sync_outbox (entity, row_key) VALUES ('zones', NEW.id);END

CREATE TRIGGER zones_outbox_update AFTER UPDATE ON zones WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sync_state WHERE name = 'applying') BEGIN DELETE FROM sync_outbox WHERE entity = 'zones' AND row_key = NEW.id;INSERT INTO sync_outbox (entity, row_key) VALUES ('zones', NEW.id);END

CREATE TRIGGER zones_outbox_delete AFTER DELETE ON zones WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sync_state WHERE name = 'applying') BEGIN DELETE FROM sync_outbox WHERE entity = 'zones' AND row_key = OLD.id;INSERT INTO sync_outbox (entity, row_key) VALUES ('zones', OLD.id);END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "inventory_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "garden_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES gardens (id), "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "stock_qty" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "low_stock_threshold" REAL NULL, "details" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TRIGGER inventory_items_outbox_insert AFTER INSERT ON inventory_items WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sync_state WHERE name = 'applying') BEGIN DELETE FROM sync_outbox WHERE entity = 'inventory_items' AND row_key = NEW.id;INSERT INTO sync_outbox (entity, row_key) VALUES ('inventory_items', NEW.id);END

CREATE TRIGGER inventory_items_outbox_delete AFTER DELETE ON inventory_items WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sync_state WHERE name = 'applying') BEGIN DELETE FROM sync_outbox WHERE entity = 'inventory_items' AND row_key = OLD.id;INSERT INTO sync_outbox (entity, row_key) VALUES ('inventory_items', OLD.id);END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "incidents" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "garden_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES gardens (id), "zone_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES zones (id), "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user', "candidates" TEXT NULL, "plan_bio" TEXT NULL, "plan_chem" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open', "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tasks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "garden_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES gardens (id), "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "zone_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES zones (id), "due" TEXT NOT NULL, "remind_at" INTEGER NULL, "rrule" TEXT NULL, "snoozed_until" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open', "notes" TEXT NULL, "completed_at" TEXT NULL, "completed_activity_id" TEXT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user', "duration_est_min" INTEGER NULL, "tools" TEXT NULL, "incident_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES incidents (id), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TRIGGER tasks_outbox_insert AFTER INSERT ON tasks WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sync_state WHERE name = 'applying') BEGIN DELETE FROM sync_outbox WHERE entity = 'tasks' AND row_key = NEW.id;INSERT INTO sync_outbox (entity, row_key) VALUES ('tasks', NEW.id);END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "activities" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "garden_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES gardens (id), "zone_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES zones (id), "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurred_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurred_tz" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "harvest_qty" REAL NULL, "harvest_unit" TEXT NULL, "cost_czk" REAL NULL, "task_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "photos" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "garden_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES gardens (id), "activity_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES activities (id), "incident_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES incidents (id), "local_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "task_materials" ("task_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id), "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES inventory_items (id), "garden_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES gardens (id), "qty" REAL NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("task_id", "item_id"));
